# 06.04-ui-smoke-tests: UI smoke tests and validation

## Objective
Run smoke tests of main UI flows and verify key windows open and basic interactions work.

## Steps
1. Build and launch the application.
2. Open main windows, create/modify data, save/load files, and observe for crashes.
3. Document failures and create follow-up tasks.

**Done when**: Smoke test checklist completed and issues logged.
